reserved_id_note: DE-W090 already owns licensing/release criteria. Never reuse it.
purpose: Connect the supplied-reader directory collector to the existing held ordinary-file source/replay mechanism without another opener or provider hierarchy.
proposed_boundary: Private synchronous ordinary-file directory acquisition only. Reuse parent pins, read-only held handle, metadata checks, exact retained region/error replay, source/process/epoch domain and test-only callbacks. Contained worker/public frontend admission follows under its own contract.
required_contract_decisions_before_code: Choose an exact public-to-this-private-call profile policy. Existing automatic bootstrap3.0 replay cannot directly support directory mode: its3.1 probe stops before directory acquisition. Either define a bounded source-bound profile-selection stage with global budgets/exact trace semantics or explicitly require Version30/Version31 and refuse Automatic before opening. Retain future automatic-profile work if using the latter boundary.
Copy nested file controls, directory reference/limits, stop predicate and test controls before callbacks. Validate all controls and signed native/window bounds before opening.

Define a separately identified directory observation/domain. Bind mode, full reference, directory limits, expected source/window/profile and process epoch. Preserve old bootstrap output/read order/domain exactly.

Use the existing native reader and final binding checks. Replay the exact full directory observer against retained responses, including incomplete/error prefixes, with complete trace consumption and no new native reads/cancellation callbacks.

Specify invalid controls, unsupported profile, real source/path refusal, partial/error/cancellation outcomes and stable/applicable distinctions before evaluating implementation. Keep source identities observational and effect/snapshot/namespace authority false.

Set independent generated-file oracles for resident/multi-level/fragmented/list/bitmap cases and native offsets above4GiB. Keep old bootstrap and local-file/root/worker/frontend regressions. Record unavailable symlink privileges and selected-architecture limitations honestly.
